address: Unit W104, 1F, West Tower, World Financial Centre, 1 Dongsanhuan Middle Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: A firm favourite among office workers in the CBD, My Soup prides itself on its comforting, umami-laden slow-boiled soups in Cantonese style. The owner, a Hong Kong native, keeps two staple soups on the menu, including the hugely popular fish maw chicken soup, plus one more on rotation – usually pork bone soup paired with different ingredients each day. As well as soups, an array of claypot rice, staples and sweet soups guarantee a fulfilling meal....
